messages:
sam_partners: Quick sync — coordinating marketplace listing with NovaGPU + LangChain connector + joint demo. Who's owning HW perf tests and announcement timeline? :calendar:

jin_eng: I can own LangChain compatibility. I'll run integration smoke tests today. Any dataset we should use?

alex_pm: I can own release timing and announcement. Prefer week of May 16. We need 2 business days for legal + marketing signoff.

maria_marketing: May 16th works. Need logos/boilerplate from NovaGPU by May 9. Also draft copy by May 12.

olivia_devex: Linking our connector guide draft: https://redwood.dev/docs/connectors/langchain-novagpu

jin_eng: Quick test update — LC runner passes on 0.38.2 but failing on 0.40 due to streaming API change. Error:
```
TypeError: stream.on is not a function
    at LangChainRunner._stream (runner.js:124)
```

jin_eng: Patch idea: switch to `client.streamTokens()` wrapper, will push PR shortly.

bert_sre: HW perf owner here. Need the workload profile (seq len, qps) and an access window to NovaGPU rig. Can we get a 2-hour slot Thurs?

sam_partners: @bert_sre I'll ask NovaGPU for Thurs 2–4p PT. Workload: 8k seq, 50 concurrent small requests (chat), 10 qps sustained. Sending details in DM.

alex_pm: Draft announcement cadence: internal preview -> private customer demo -> public blog + marketplace tile. Timeline in doc: https://docs.google.com/announce-plan

maria_marketing: For marketplace tile we need pricing tiers, supported regions, and a 'tested with' badge. Can engineering confirm regions?

jin_eng: Verified: us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Quantized model variant tested on NovaGPU 80GB.

olivia_devex: UI/SDK notes — we'll add a sample snippet for LangChain 0.38 and a migration note for 0.40 in the guide.

sam_partners: Owner checklist:
- Sam: partner comms + legal
- Alex: announce timing
- Jin: LangChain integration + PR
- Bert: HW perf tests
- Maria: marketing assets
- Olivia: docs/SDK samples

maria_marketing: I'll need logo assets + contact for approvals by EOD May 9.

deploy-bot: deploy 2024-05-02 19:02:12 UTC — docs branch langchain-novagpu merged

sam_partners: Thanks all. I'll bump if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
